messages.text: I have had my miner for a few months. And it threw a code and stopped working. How do I go about getting this covered under the warranty
Handed to the team · Warranty length/terms not something I can quote

Sorry it quit on you. Faulty units go through RMA: fill in the intake form and you'll get a return label, then processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse. Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

One thing first: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Those aren't covered.

I'm confirming the exact warranty terms for your model with the team, they're offline until tomorrow 10am ET and the answer comes to your email. What's the order number and the code it showed?
Not overclocked or modified. Order number Shop····

Good, that keeps you covered. Go ahead and submit the RMA form now with Shop···· and the error code, that starts the label and saves you a few days.

To pull the order up and get the warranty terms to you, what's the email on it? The team's back tomorrow at 10am ET and their answer goes to that address, along with a copy of this chat.

What code is the unit showing?

Got it, the NerdQX was delivered August 10, so it's well inside a couple of months. Not overclocked means it's a straightforward RMA.

Submit the form with Shop···· and the code, and you'll get a return label. Processing is up to 10 days after it lands at the warehouse. If it turns out to be the PSU, they can send just that, no full return.

The exact warranty terms for the NerdQX come to (email hidden) tomorrow after 10am ET. What code is it throwing?
Code is vreg overheated, and voltage protection. I checked the fuse and it looks fine. The small fan in the front seems to have stopped working and is very hard to spin.

That points straight at the fan. A seized fan lets the voltage regulator cook, and the board cuts out on voltage protection to save itself. Don't run it again until the fan is fixed.

Ours may be able to send a fan rather than take the whole unit back, so hold off shipping anything yet. I've put it to the team with your notes, they pick it up tomorrow after 10am ET and reply to (email hidden)

Photo of the fan and the error screen will speed it up if you have one.

Thanks, I'll take that as the unit's serial and I've added it to your case. Shout if it's something else.

Nothing more you need to do tonight. The team has your order, the codes and the fan symptom, and they reply to (email hidden) after 10am ET tomorrow with the warranty terms and whether it's a fan they can send out or a full return.

Keep it powered off until then.
Sounds good thanks for everything.have a good Sunday
You too, and sorry the NerdQX gave you trouble. A copy of this whole chat lands in your inbox once we're done here, so you'll have the details in writing. Watch for the team's mail tomorrow.
